measure.searchQuery: site:booking.com New York City United States hostel private room 2 adults price per night
measure.reason: The Hostelworld search returned only from-prices and generic private-room listings, without a dated non-from price tied to two guests. The Booking.com search showed hostel-list pages with 1-night/2-adult context but only from-prices or generic private-room comments; a West Side YMCA private double room snippet showed max adults 2 and $223 per night, but the extracted source did not clearly establish the property as a hostel under this contract. Other exact New York results were guest houses or hotels rather than hostels. No qualifying two-adult hostel private-room value was retained.
